text: For the director of music. Of David. In the Lord I take refuge. How then can you say to me: “Flee like a bird to your mountain.
they set their arrows against the strings to shoot from the shadows at the upright in heart.
the Lord is on his heavenly throne. He observes the sons of men; his eyes examine them.
but the wicked and those who love violence his soul hates.
fiery coals and burning sulfur; a scorching wind will be their lot.
he loves justice; upright men will see his face.
